conclusion: Fresh games are intentionally randomized. Identical host replay keys/timestamps do not establish matching game-clock samples, live RNG state or generated worlds. Equal explicit per-yard seeds support a controlled world comparison only with equal generation parameters, resources and relevant prestate; arbitrary screenshots need not match.
seeding_chain: initStuff calls SeedSRand, then SeedRRand. SeedRRand again seeds private16-bit S state from low16(TickCount) XOR3751h, consumes one SRand128 draw, seeds MSC CRT rand with a second low16(TickCount) sample, then discards that many (0..127) CRT draws.
TickCount is the game INT08 counter (starts0, tick_count_on starts1), not a host wall-time value. Its actual samples in the earlier DOS comparison runs were not captured.
NewGame initializes the selected game mode and invokes RandYard. RandYard draws192 values from the current CRT RRand stream into the16x12 per-yard seed table and selects table[y8][x11] for RandWorld.

RandWorld first SetSRandSeed(selected_seed), then builds MapA terrain and resets/builds MapB/MapR, ExitMapB/ExitMapR and Life maps, clears pheromone maps and initializes colonies. Output also depends on black/red sizes, patchcoordinates, TERRAINset, mode/resources and relevant helper prestate. No complete RandWorld world-array differential corpus is claimed here.

XferPatch reuses the stored seed table entry for the selected yard, together with that yard's saved colony sizes/coordinates. Simulation thereafter consumes both RNG streams; input/tick history can change call order/count.

save_load.CRT_state_authority: Actual original srand writes7BBE/7BC0, rand reads/updates the same four bytes. All307 original SaveRec intervals checked for overlap; none covers either RNG range.
save_load.load_order: Before reading records, LoadGame calls o09_35F5_0D7A→RandYard, advancing live RNG streams and generating temporary state. Loaded records overwrite stored maps/lists/yard seeds; o09_35F5_0DBB rebuilds LifeA/B/R from loaded lists and the player. No explicit private-S or CRT RNG restore/reseed follows the record read.
save_load.implication: Saving/restoring world data and per-yard generation seeds does not restore the exact ongoing RNG sequence. Equal loaded terrain does not imply identical future simulation or future new-game seeds.
save_load.GetRRandSeed: Unused helper reads physical046C:0000; it is not the CRT rand internal state. SetRRandSeed is empty. Neither supplies a save/load RNG restore.

bounded_original_seed_table_control.positive: Same two clock samples and same CRT history produce identical384-byte table and selectedyardseed.
bounded_original_seed_table_control.negative: Changing clock samples or consuming one prior RRand draw changes the table and selected seed.
bounded_original_seed_table_control.scope: Actual original SeedRRand/RRand/ClrArrays/InitSimYard/ClearHistory/RandYard. initControls is an explicit no-op UI boundary; RandWorld intercepted at entry. No world-generation or DOS source-image seed comparison claim.

retained_regression.scope: Actual canonical root0093 plus CRT/seed services vs original helpers, controlled clocks and physical seed reader; zero-divisor negative. Source, fixture, service and VM hashes still match that receipt. No new duplicate model or game seed override introduced.

limits: Randomness does not excuse a differing implementation under equal controlled state/seed/input contracts.
No RNG cause assigned to prior differing DOS frames without actual seed/call-history traces.
Save/Load interoperability and semantic replay belong to the separate live DOS receipt; this finding alone does not prove them.
